_about: Tailnet setup (catalogue Id 63), shared by every PC. Edited by hand in the repo. allowFrom: the only addresses that may reach SSH (22), RDP (3389) and ping; never Any. authorizedKeys: public keys only (type + key, no comments), ADDED to %ProgramData%\ssh\administrators_authorized_keys, existing lines are kept. tailscale: tailscale set flags (unattended = runs before anyone signs in).
